meta_description: Range Plastering in Manchester offers professional internal and external plastering. Expert finishes, competitive rates, local team. Call 07307 896615 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Smooth walls and professional finishes for your Manchester home or business. Quality plasterwork that lasts.
services_subhead: From interior skimming to external rendering, we handle every plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Skimming & Plasterboard
services.desc: Smooth, flawless plasterboard finishing and skimmed ceilings. Perfect preparation for decoration and a factory-fresh wall surface.

services.title: External Rendering & Pebbledashing
services.desc: Weather-resistant external renders and pebbledash coatings. Protects your property and enhances kerb appeal for years to come.

services.title: Artexing & Textured Finishes
services.desc: Specialist textured coatings including artex, popcorn, and bespoke finishes. Adds character and hides minor wall imperfections.

services.title: Dry Lining & Partition Walls
services.desc: Fast, clean dry lining installation and partition walls. Ideal for renovations, extensions, and creating new spaces.

services.title: Patch Repair & Damage Restoration
services.desc: Expert repair of cracks, water damage, and impact marks. Colour-matched finishes that blend seamlessly with existing plaster.

services.title: Specialist Coatings & Insulation Board
services.desc: Thermal insulation boards with plaster finish and specialist base coat systems. Improves energy efficiency whilst creating smooth, durable walls.

about_pullquote: We take pride in finishes that stand the test of time and keep our customers coming back.
about_para_1: Range Plastering was established over a decade ago in Manchester with a simple goal: deliver the cleanest, most professional plasterwork in the city. We've grown steadily through word-of-mouth, completing hundreds of jobs for homeowners, landlords, and builders across Greater Manchester. Our reputation is built on attention to detail and honest pricing — no hidden charges, no shortcuts.
about_para_2: Every member of our team is a skilled tradesperson with years of hands-on experience. We turn up on time, leave your property clean, and stand behind our work with full guarantees. Customers trust us because we treat every wall as if it were our own home.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Range Plastering

reviews.text: Needed the whole living room replastered after damp treatment. Lads were brilliant — quick, tidy, and the finish is spotless. Quoted £450, came in on budget. Would use again without question.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had a bathroom renovation and Range did all the skimming and external render on a side wall. Professional crew, no mess, finished dead on schedule. Really pleased with the quality. Recommended them to my brother already.
reviews.author: Emma H.

reviews.text: Called in to sort out cracks and patch work on our dining room after some settling. They matched the existing plaster perfectly — honestly couldn't tell where the repair was. Fair pricing and friendly lads. Top job.
reviews.author: Mark T.
